title: Directive (EU) 2018/1972 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 December 2018 establishing the European Electronic Communications Code (Recast)
scope: The EU regulatory framework for electronic communications networks and services, associated facilities and services, and certain aspects of terminal equipment: national regulatory authorities, general authorisation, radio spectrum, numbering, access and interconnection, significant market power, universal service, and end-user rights.
examples: What procedure must a national regulatory authority follow before imposing obligations on an undertaking with significant market power?
Which end-user rights apply to number-independent interpersonal communications services, and which are excluded?

versions.note: Text as published in the Official Journal (OJ L 321, 17.12.2018). Kept for comparison only; not the version in use.

Latest consolidated text on EUR-Lex, checked 7 October 2026 (125 articles, against 127 in the Official Journal text). Consolidated texts are documentation tools and have no legal effect; only the Official Journal text is authentic.
